title: APCW-2025-4181-CDP-SPPE-SPPC
text:
APCW-2025-4181-CDP-SPPE-SPPC  Council District: 11 – Park
  CEQA: ENV-2025-4182-CE  Last Day to Act: 11-09-26
  Plan Area: Venice

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed September 22, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  606, 610, 620, 636, 640, 648, and 654 East Venice Boulevard

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Exterior and interior improvements to an existing 38,661 square foot software manufacturing campus
  (Buildings A1, A2, B, C, D and E); and the change of use of 36,902 square feet of light manufacturing uses
  (Buildings A1, A2, B, D and E) to commercial uses including retail, office, restaurants and fitness, resulting
  in a lot developed with a commercial center providing 38,661 square feet of commercial uses including
  retail, office, fitness, restaurants (restaurant uses providing a maximum Service Floor area of 4,500 square
  feet for indoor and outdoor dining area), and a minimum of 3,690 square feet of manufacturing uses,
  providing 108 bicycle parking spaces and 90 vehicle parking spaces on-site.
  .
  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, an Exemption from CEQA
  pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Article 19, Section 15301 (Class 1), and that there is no substantial
  evidence demonstrating that an exception to a categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines,
  Section 15300.2 applies;
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1A Section 13B.9.1 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Coastal
  Development Permit for the Proposed Project on a lot located within the Single Permit Jurisdiction of
  the Coastal Zone;
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.4.5, a Project Exception from the Venice Coastal Zone
  Specific Plan to permit 90 vehicular parking spaces in lieu of the maximum required 144 spaces; and
  4. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.4.2, a Project Compliance for a project located within the
  Southeast Venice Subarea of the Venice Coastal Zone Specific Plan.

  Applicant:  Carolwood Venice, LLC; Venice ARE Venture, LLC
  Representative: Kevin Scott, Brian Silveira & Associates

  Staff:  Luis Lopez, Planning Assistant
  luis.lopez@lacity.org
  (213) 978-1359
summary: The West Los Angeles Area Planning Commission is considering a coastal development permit and related approvals to convert part of a software manufacturing campus on East Venice Boulevard into a commercial center with retail, offices, fitness and restaurants. The project keeps at least 3,690 square feet of manufacturing use and provides 90 parking spaces.
